lf-playground.description: A form whose fields the user tunes against a live preview, comparing candidates, and sends as one configuration.
lf-playground.instructions: Write its fields as native form controls: each `input`, `select` or `textarea` with a `name` is one, and radios that share a name are one. An `<aside>` directly inside stands in the rail beside the preview; everything else it holds, except presets and its one `lf-playground-output`, is the preview. `<output for="NAME">` shows field NAME's value. A `<button type="submit">` written inside, with an optional `<button type="reset">`, takes the place of the bar of actions Leaf draws.

lf-playground-preset.description: A named partial playground configuration the user can apply at once.
lf-playground-preset.instructions: A control the preset has no setting for keeps its current value.

lf-playground-setting.description: One control value applied by a playground preset.
lf-playground-setting.instructions: Set for to the name of a field in the same playground and write value as that field's `value` attribute would: a number for a range or number input, true or false for a checkbox, a radio's or option's value, and for a `<select multiple>` the values of the options it selects, separated by spaces.

lf-playground-output.description: The task instruction displayed by a playground and sent with the chosen configuration; an `<output for>` inside shows a field's value.
